properties.name: name
properties.description: Assign a unique object name within its DSS class. The collection takes it as the separate name argument.

properties.name: phases
properties.description: Number of electrical phases. Transformer allocates one extra conductor per terminal for the neutral connection.

properties.name: windings
properties.description: Number of windings. This package supports 2 and 3. A valid write reinitializes the winding records. Set Windings before supplying winding data.

properties.name: pctr
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Percent winding resistance on the winding-1 kVA base. DSS text uses %R for the selected winding and %Rs for an array. Recomputes pctLoadLoss from windings 1 and 2.

properties.name: rneut
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Wye neutral resistance in ohms. A negative value leaves the internal neutral open. Bus node assignments separately control external grounding.

properties.name: xneut
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Wye neutral reactance in ohms. Can be positive or negative.

properties.name: buses
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Transformer bus names with optional node suffixes. The engine lowercases names and generates initial buses using the object name. Supply explicit buses for a usable model.

properties.name: conns
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Winding connection. Python reads Connection members (wye=0 and delta=1) and accepts enum values, integers, or strings.

properties.name: kvs
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Rated winding voltage in kV. Use line-to-line kV for three-phase transformers and voltage across the winding for single-phase transformers.

properties.name: kvas
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Rated winding power in kVA. The first winding establishes the impedance base and recalculates NormHkVA and EmergHkVA.

properties.name: taps
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Per-unit voltage ratio taps. Ordinary Transformer Taps and DSS tap property writes store values directly. Use the configured tap limits when choosing values.

properties.name: xhl
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 1 and 2 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of X12.

properties.name: xht
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 1 and 3 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of X13. Applies to three windings.

properties.name: xlt
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 2 and 3 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of X23. Applies to three windings.

properties.name: xscarray
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance array on the winding-1 kVA base. Use [X12] or [X12, X13, X23]. Explicit array writes leave scalar readbacks intact. A later scalar edit rebuilds the array from the scalar family. A bare two-winding Transformer reads [7]. After resizing to three windings it reads [7, 30, 30] until an impedance family is set.

properties.name: thermal
properties.description: Thermal time constant in hours. The pinned engine registers this input as unused.

properties.name: n
properties.description: Thermal exponent n for full-load temperature rise. The pinned engine registers this input as unused.

properties.name: m
properties.description: Thermal exponent m for hot-spot temperature rise. The pinned engine registers this input as unused.

properties.name: flrise
properties.description: Full-load temperature rise in degrees Celsius. The pinned engine registers this input as unused.

properties.name: hsrise
properties.description: Hot-spot temperature rise in degrees Celsius. The pinned engine registers this input as unused.

properties.name: pctloadloss
properties.description: Percent load loss on the winding-1 kVA base. A write splits the value evenly between the first two winding resistances.

properties.name: pctnoloadloss
properties.description: No-load loss in percent of winding-1 kVA, represented by the core-loss branch.

properties.name: normhkva
properties.description: Normal service rating in kVA. A kVAs write or a scalar kVA edit on winding 1 resets it to 1.1 times winding-1 kVA.

properties.name: emerghkva
properties.description: Emergency service rating in kVA. A kVAs write or a scalar kVA edit on winding 1 resets it to 1.5 times winding-1 kVA.

properties.name: sub
properties.description: Substation designation flag for reporting.

properties.name: maxtap
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Maximum per-unit tap for the tap-changing control path. DSS text uses the selected winding.

properties.name: mintap
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Minimum per-unit tap for the tap-changing control path. DSS text uses the selected winding.

properties.name: numtaps
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Number of tap steps spanning MinTap to MaxTap. DSS text uses the selected winding.

properties.name: subname
properties.description: Substation name used for reporting.

properties.name: pctimag
properties.description: No-load magnetizing current as a percentage of rated current.

properties.name: ppm_antifloat
properties.description: Anti-float admittance factor in parts per million. The engine scales this input by 1e-6.

properties.name: pctrs
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Array alias of pctR in Python. The DSS array keyword is %Rs. The first two winding values determine pctLoadLoss.

properties.name: bank
properties.description: Name used to identify the transformer bank in exports.

properties.name: xfmrcode
properties.description: Reference to an XfmrCode object by name or object. Assignment copies phases, windings and transformer parameters at that moment. Assign before buses and local overrides. The constructor starts without a code.

properties.name: xrconst
properties.description: Keep the reactance-to-resistance ratio constant as frequency changes.

properties.name: x12
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 1 and 2 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of XHL.

properties.name: x13
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 1 and 3 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of XHT. Applies to three windings.

properties.name: x23
properties.description: Percent short-circuit reactance between windings 2 and 3 on the winding-1 kVA base. Alias of XLT. Applies to three windings.

properties.name: leadlag
properties.description: HV-to-LV phase displacement convention for mixed wye/delta connections. PhaseSequence.Lag=0 and Lead=1.

properties.name: core
properties.description: Transformer core type. CoreType values are shell=0, one_phase=1, three_leg=3, four_leg=4, five_leg=5, and core_1_phase=9.

properties.name: rdcohms
properties.description: One value per winding in winding order. Winding DC resistance in ohms. For Transformer, the derived value is abs(0.85 times Rpu) times winding voltage base squared divided by winding-1 VA. Use DSS wdg and RDCOhms for each winding that must retain an explicit value after recalculation.

properties.name: seasons
properties.description: Number of seasonal kVA ratings. Set before Ratings so the engine sizes the rating array.

properties.name: ratings
properties.description: Seasonal kVA ratings in season order. Match Seasons.

properties.name: normamps
properties.description: Inherited normal current rating in amperes. Transformer recalculation derives it from NormHkVA, phases and the winding-1 voltage factor.

properties.name: emergamps
properties.description: Inherited emergency current rating in amperes. Transformer recalculation derives it from EmergHkVA, phases and the winding-1 voltage factor.

properties.name: faultrate
properties.description: Inherited expected failure rate per year.

properties.name: pctperm
properties.description: Inherited percentage of faults that become permanent.

properties.name: repair
properties.description: Inherited repair time in hours after a permanent fault.

properties.name: basefreq
properties.description: Inherited base frequency in Hz, initialized from the active circuit fundamental.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Inherited flag controlling whether the transformer participates in the circuit solution.

properties.name: like
properties.description: Copy settings from another object of the same class. Creation keyword and action method with no getter.

properties.name: wdg
properties.description: Select a winding using its 1-based index before reading or writing the scalar values. DSS text scalar access uses Wdg. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: bus
properties.description: Bus and optional node suffixes for the selected winding. The initial bus depends on the transformer name. DSS text scalar access uses Bus. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: conn
properties.description: Connection of the selected winding. The text query reads wye or delta. DSS text scalar access uses Conn. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: kv
properties.description: Rated winding voltage in kV. The engine specification sets use this property; kVs is its array alternative. DSS text scalar access uses kV. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: kva
properties.description: Rated kVA of the selected winding. A winding-1 write also sets the other winding ratings and resets normal and emergency kVA. In a two-winding model a winding-2 scalar write also updates winding 1. DSS text scalar access uses kVA. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: tap
properties.description: Per-unit tap of the selected winding. The Transformer text property stores it directly even outside MinTap and MaxTap. DSS text scalar access uses Tap. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: %r
properties.description: Percent series resistance of the selected winding on the winding-1 kVA base. The engine stores the per-unit value and updates pctLoadLoss. DSS text scalar access uses %R. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: rneut_scalar
properties.description: Wye neutral resistance in ohms for the selected winding. Negative values leave the internal neutral open. DSS text scalar access uses RNeut. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

properties.name: xneut_scalar
properties.description: Wye neutral reactance in ohms for the selected winding. DSS text scalar access uses XNeut. The pinned wrapper has no winding-selector scalar accessor.

conditional.when: choosing an explicit engine specification set
conditional.notes: Engine groups use scalar kV with kVs as its array alternative. Buses supplies wiring for each set. XfmrCode is ordered first. The Python constructor itself can allocate with only name.

altdss_mapping: ctx.Transformer.new(name, **properties) creates the object. Python winding data is array-valued. DSS text has a separate wdg-selected scalar path.

sources.title: DSS C-API Transformer engine
sources.scope: Property registration, specification sets, default values, and write effects.

notes: Scope covers two and three windings. Arrays are in 1-based winding order except XSCArray and Ratings, which are ordered by winding pair and season respectively.
Default values describe a fresh two-winding object. Null includes generated, context-dependent, derived, absent, or action-only values. See the readback matrix for each case.
WindingCurrents(), WindingVoltages(winding), and LossesByType() are methods. The engine WdgCurrents text result is recorded in the engine catalog.
